systems.notes: Centered selection shown at the start of each detected PEAK run; no F1 toggle and no top HUD.
Pudge Meat Hook and Tiny Toss are processed independently of shop/event UI; Z avoids PEAK Q drop/throw.
+5 Gold every 45 seconds plus sellable PEAK loot.
Lower-left shop button and clickable item cards.
X replaces R because PEAK uses R for emotes.
Timed caches, mountain anomaly and opportunity events.
Blink uses C; Boots and Blink ownership reset when a new run is detected.
Hero/item ownership is no longer used as permanent run progression; purchased items reset at each new run.
